name: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
source:
A dystopian Disco-inspired adult VN setting you in the shoes of a mid-level official taking turns exploiting, torching, or succumbing to the bureaucratic madness of a dying sci-fi regime.

There are no cults or apocalyptic end-times - only the gears of the world turning and crushing men in their wake. The impossible task of fixing this faltering machine is yours - but who's looking if you bang a few women in between the dotted lines?

[From [url=https://munitions-mori.itch.io/imperial-bureaucracy-hero]itch.io[/url]]
